t: This joint resolution shall be implemented so that only the most limited funding action of that permitted in the joint resolution shall be taken in order to provide for continuation of projects and activities.

fable.w: This is a continuing-resolution provision directing that funding actions be kept to the minimum needed to continue projects and activities. The tempting reading is that "projects and activities" or "implemented" implies some outside process, but no party outside the federal government is consulted, heard, or given a right to sue or object. It is purely an internal appropriations instruction, so it is not participation.
fable.s: only the most limited funding action of that permitted in the joint resolution shall be taken in order to provide for continuation of projects and activities

opus.w: This is standard appropriations wording that tells agencies to take only the most limited funding action allowed under the joint resolution. Nothing in it brings states, tribes, experts, companies or the public into a federal decision. Words like "action" and "implemented" do not, on their own, create any process involving outside parties, so the provision does not count as participation.
opus.b:
1. **Tempting wrong reading:** The words "joint resolution," "implemented," and "funding action" sound procedural, so this could look like a federal decision process. But this is standard continuing-resolution wording that limits how funds may be spent. It involves no one outside the federal government: no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking or right to sue.

qwen_chat.w: The section is a directive regarding the scope of federal funding appropriations. It does not mention any requirement to consult, coordinate with, or receive input from state governments, local governments, the public, or other non-federal entities. The actors involved are implicitly federal officials implementing the resolution, which falls under intra-governmental action.
qwen_chat.s: This joint resolution shall be implemented so that only the most limited funding action of that permitted in the joint resolution shall be taken in order to provide for continuation of projects and activities.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "continuation of projects and activities" implies ongoing interaction with external parties, but the text itself contains no mechanism for consultation, comment, or coordination with anyone outside the federal government. It is purely a directive on the scope of funding.
